node.statement: Dependency check for this case-split step: node 1.2 is now epistemic_state=validated, and the other direct validation dependencies of node 1.4.4, namely 1.1, 1.3, 1.4.1, 1.4.2, and 1.4.3, are also validated. Therefore the earlier objection that 1.4.4 used an unvalidated direct dependency no longer applies; the case split may use the validated q >= q0 branch 1.4.2 and the validated q < q0 branch 1.4.3, with the substitution of N and D supplied by validated node 1.1.
